comparison.objective: Rethread a hoodie drawstring through its fabric casing.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cord advancement with a threader and preservation of the trailing end versus rigid many-body filtration.
comparison.success_condition: Cord follows casing with ≥8 cm at each opening, intact and released 3 s; lost trailing end or damage overrides credit.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable routing through a hidden channel.
